decisions.placement: T2 §1 after Min recipe/time paragraphs and before the paragraph beginning The options in a data-limited setting. Suggested heading: Ensemble Count Is a Separate Allocation Variable. This is survey synthesis, not a direct claim of response to Min.
decisions.proposal_en:
Retuning repeated-data training also leaves a choice between enlarging one model and training several predictors. Baron et al. (27 October 2026) fit learning-rate and weight-decay prescriptions across unique data, model size and epochs, then add independent ensemble count as a separate loss variable. Larger individual models and more ensemble members need not have the same overfitting effect. Their FineWeb fitting grid spans 25M–400M unique tokens and 30M–398M counted parameters; predictions are combined by averaging token probabilities, with snapshots and weights selected on a separate calibration set.

On 100M unique tokens, the combined recipe improves validation loss by over 0.15 nats against their fixed-hyperparameter baseline without independent ensembles and tests allocation at up to 12 times the fitting budget. This is distinct from the 16-times hyperparameter-transfer test. The budget proxy is $6UNRM$, where $U$ counts unique tokens, $R$ epochs and $M$ independent runs; $N$ includes output projections but excludes input and value-embedding tables. It omits calibration, snapshot-serving and tuning costs, while batch size stays fixed. Thus the result expands the allocation problem, without establishing a deployment optimum or a universal remedy for data exhaustion. The companion blog's quadrillion-parameter numbers extrapolate to vastly larger budgets and sum parameters across ensemble members; they are not trained-model measurements.
decisions.proposal_zh:
重复数据训练经过重新调参后，仍需选择扩大单个模型，还是训练多个预测器。Baron 等（2026 年 10 月 27 日）针对独特数据量、模型规模与 epoch 数拟合学习率和权重衰减处方，再将独立集成成员数加入损失模型。扩大单个模型与增加集成成员，对过拟合的影响未必相同。其 FineWeb 拟合网格覆盖 25M–400M 独特 token 和 30M–398M 计入规模的参数；输出按 token 概率平均，并用独立校准集选择快照及权重。

在 100M 独特 token 上，联合配方相比作者不使用独立模型集成的固定超参数基线降低验证损失超过 0.15 nats，并在最高为拟合预算 12 倍的配置上检验分配处方。这不同于 16 倍预算的超参数迁移检验。预算代理为 $6UNRM$，其中 $U$ 计独特 token，$R$ 计 epoch，$M$ 计独立训练次数；$N$ 包含输出投影，却不含输入与 value embedding 表。代理不计校准、快照部署和调参成本，batch size 也保持固定。因此，该结果扩大了资源分配问题，并未建立部署最优解或数据耗尽的通用补救方法。配套 blog 的千万亿参数数字外推至远大于实测的预算，并将各集成成员参数相加，不能当作已经训练出的模型规模。

source_record.title: Rewriting Scaling Laws for Synthetic Data with Compute and Data Constraints
source_record.problem: Synthetic rewrites change distribution and incur generation cost; optimal mixture and a teacher capability ceiling cannot be inferred from token counts.
source_record.insight: Optimize a repetition- and mixture-aware loss under a marginal budget that charges both target training and rewrite generation.
source_record.method: Qwen3 dense/Adam+Hyperball, FineWeb-Edu and FinePhrase; rewrite-dependent floor and repetition penalty; forward budget holdouts,22B target and5B-token finite-data seed experiments.
source_record.result: 32% rewrite22B target has1.1% forecast error in a33.3x training-budget extrapolation; beats instruct rewriter on10/16 Paloma sources but not macroBPB. Data-limited heldout mixture selection within1.14% of best tested loss.
source_record.limitation: Teacher pretraining excluded; equal source/rewrite lengths and FLOP-bound generation assumed.22B controls share training cost, not generation-inclusive total. Rewriters receive external SFT and LM-judge selection. Pair-specific fits, four styles and limited sources; no universal optimum or general capability superiority.

decisions.placement: T2 §9 after WildAI and before §10. Suggested heading: Rewriting Has a Generation Cost and a Budget-Dependent Mixture. Survey comparison distinguishes curated rewrite intervention from wildAI additions.
decisions.proposal_en:
Synthetic rewriting introduces another budget decision: when should compute create new views of existing documents instead of training longer? Roberts et al. (22 October 2026) jointly model parameter count, training tokens, rewrite fraction and natural-data repetition. Their allocation charges target training plus approximate source-prefill and rewrite-decoding FLOPs; it excludes rewriter pretraining and assumes equal source/rewrite lengths. Rewrites alter the fitted loss floor, an empirical modeling choice rather than a universal mechanism.

A forecast fitted through $3\times10^{20}$ training FLOPs predicts a roughly 22B model trained near $10^{22}$ FLOPs: its 32% rewrite mixture yields Paloma loss within 1.1% of the forecast and beats the other tested fractions. The four runs share model size and training tokens, so their generation-inclusive budgets differ. The target outperforms the instruction-tuned rewriter on 10 of 16 Paloma sources, while its macro BPB remains worse, 0.983 versus 0.972; neither result establishes general capability superiority.

The finite-data experiments use a 5B-token seed set and size-matched rewriters. Those rewriters also receive 7M tokens of GLM-5.2-generated instruction tuning and LM-judge checkpoint selection, so this is not a closed information loop. Fits are separate for each target–rewriter pair; source quality, rewrite styles and evaluation change the preferred mixture. The contribution makes generation cost and repetition explicit allocation variables, while leaving total pipeline cost and broader transfer unresolved.
decisions.proposal_zh:
合成改写引入了另一项预算选择：何时应把计算用于为原文生成新表述，而不是继续训练？Roberts 等（2026 年 10 月 22 日）联合建模参数量、训练 token、改写比例和自然数据重复。其分配同时计入目标训练、近似的原文 prefill 与改写 decode FLOPs；不计改写器预训练，并假设原文与改写长度相等。改写改变拟合的损失下限，这是一项经验建模选择，而非普适机制。

使用最高 $3\times10^{20}$ 训练 FLOPs 拟合的预测，外推到约 $10^{22}$ FLOPs 的约 22B 模型：32% 改写混合的 Paloma 损失与预测相差不超过 1.1%，并优于其余已测比例。四个运行共享模型规模和训练 token，因此计入生成后的总预算不同。目标模型在 16 个 Paloma 来源中的 10 个优于指令微调后的改写器，但宏平均 BPB 仍较差，为 0.983 对 0.972；两者均不能建立一般能力上的全面超越。

有限数据实验使用 5B-token 种子集和同规模改写器。后者还接受 7M token 的 GLM-5.2 生成指令微调，并由 LM judge 选择检查点，因此不是封闭的信息循环。每组目标模型与改写器分别拟合；来源质量、改写风格和评估目标都会改变偏好的混合。该工作将生成成本与重复显式纳入分配变量，但完整流程成本与更广泛迁移仍待检验。
